name: reading-column
title: Reading column
description: A comfortable reading measure where figures, tables and code can break out wider, or all the way to the edge.
docs: Children sit in the text column, measure wide (50 by default). measure is in ch, the width of a zero in the column's font, and not a count of characters: a zero is wider than the average letter, so 50ch holds about 60 to 75 characters on a line, depending on the font. ReadingColumn.Wide takes the width of the page content (wideWidth, 72rem) and ReadingColumn.Full runs edge to edge, for pictures, tables, code and pull quotes. Every track is sized from the grid itself and not from viewport units, so a wide or full child never causes sideways scroll, and on a phone everything collapses into one column with gutters (the fluid gutters of Container). gap is the space between blocks (sm, md, lg or any length) and as renders a div, article, main or section. Put the column in a parent that is as wide as the page, so Full can reach the edges.
